main.description: Author a content node in a context (Phase 1: the authenticated caller becomes the sole author). Requires authentication; the caller's DID is taken from the request's authorization, not the body.

parent_id.description: The parent node, which must be live and in that context. Absent hangs the document directly off the context.

title.description: The name. The server derives the slug from it (`name`, then `name-2`, ...) and with it the path.

content.description: The Slate document JSON, stored verbatim.

data.description: What the node holds beside its text: a file's id and type, a cover image. An object.

slug.description: The URL segment it was given: made from the title, and numbered if that was taken.

path.description: Where it is, so a screen that has just made it can go straight there.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a member of that context, the kind is an owner's to create (folder, document, file, position), or the parent is locked and the caller is not an owner.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: `parent_id` names no live node or one in another context, the kind is not one that is created this way, or that kind does not go under that parent (a policy goes in a folder, a candidate under a position).
